services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: From Ucluelet, BC on the west coast of Vancouver Island, we have access to some of the best Salmon and Halibut fishing on Earth. The area is home to an abundance of bait fish including Krill, Pilchards, Squid, Herring and Anchovies. The pristine conditions allow for a population of Chinook, Coho, Pink, and Sockeye

variants.label: Fishing for Salmon and Halibut from Ucluelet, BC

blurb: Guests fish for Chinook, Coho, Pink, and Sockeye Salmon, Lingcod, and Halibut in pristine waters rich with bait fish. Wildlife viewing tours offer chances to see land and sea animals including blacktail deer, sea otters, bears, eagles, sea lions, and seals. Tours create opportunities for memorable fishing and wildlife photography experiences.
